source.basis: Rounded national-average retail prices recalled from well-known public sources (BLS CPI average prices, USDA, EIA, AAA, STR, DOT, FDA/KFF) and published list prices; not queried live. Apply regions.cost_of_living_multiplier to scale for local conditions (it moves most goods less than rent). Sales tax is not included.

unit.doc: The quantity the price applies to (1 gallon, per night, per month, …).

price_cents.doc: National-average band before regional scaling; the economy pack applies cost_of_living_multiplier.

eggs_large.name: Eggs, grade A large
eggs_large.notes: 2025 prices swung strongly (avian flu); typical shown is a mid-2025 to early-2026 blend
